description: Reviewed labels for refined shape subclusters of coarse cluster 044 in the body-crop test cluster set. The coarse cluster is globally assigned as connected tau-pi, but subcluster 03 isolates the rounded upsilon-pi connected form.

03.label: ⲩⲡ
03.evidence: Subcluster 03 is a coherent connected upsilon-pi family in montage and spread context samples; includes p012 l21 b8, review index 741, where the first glyph is upsilon rather than tau.
